architecture: UNet++ 2D (nested skips, no deep supervision), DoubleConv blocks, bilinear upsampling
tta: flip (none, LR, UD, both), softmax mean
postprocessing: remove 26-connected components of labels [3, 4] smaller than N voxels; N chosen on pooled CV from [0, 2, 3, 5, 8, 10, 15, 20, 30, 50]
selection_rule: mean per-patient 3D Dice over val patients with GT
lr_scheduler_cv: CosineAnnealingLR(T_max=120, eta_min=1e-06), start lr=0.0001, stepped once per epoch
lr_scheduler_final: CosineAnnealingLR(T_max=84, eta_min=1e-06), start lr=0.0001, stepped once per epoch
seed_rule: RANDOM_SEED + fold (final model: RANDOM_SEED, as script 14)
dice_loss: batch-level soft Dice, smooth=1.0, background excluded

augmentation.spatial: h-flip, v-flip, rot90 on all channels + label
augmentation.intensity: scale/shift on MRI channels (all context slices), brain voxels only

epoch_rule: median of 5 CV best epochs, fixed before test evaluation
lr_schedule_rule: final model anneals over its own final_epochs (T_max=final_epochs); CV folds used T_max=EPOCHS
postprocessing_rule: chosen on pooled CV before test; primary test result = with post-processing
